title: How to Use the Panel Rack in Project P.I.T.T.
description: After the 1.0.6 update the Panel Rack uses a dedicated Panel Rack key (check your current mapping in controls). The Rack no longer automatically dispenses the next panel after you place one — press the Panel Rack key again to obtain the next panel. The dedicated keybind must be used each time to retrieve another panel; do not assume the old auto-dispense behavior. The tool lives in Automation → Shift Scheduler → Trade Terminal → Panel Rack → x300 Combo. If panels do not appear automatically that is the intended post-1.0.6 behavior; older saves or update-state differences have been reported but exact migration behavior is unconfirmed. Questions about unlocking Tier 3 remain unresolved: no reliable exact higher-tier prerequisite is available, so check the in-game unlock UI for your save. Common mistakes: expecting automatic dispense, assuming the previous key or tier is unchanged, not checking current key mapping, or not verifying unlock status in the UI. Use the Panel Rack in automation chains and x300 Combo setups as part of Shift Scheduler flows. For setup and integration see the Automation guide and the x300 Combo guide; for broken/missing Rack or save migration issues see the Troubleshooting guide.
